sanskrit_verse:
ज्ञातिसंबन्धिसुहृदाम ऋणं देयं सबन्धकम् ।
अन्येषां लग्नकोपेतं लेख्यसाक्षियुतं तथा ॥
transliteration: jñātisaṃbandhisuhṛdām ṛṇaṃ deyaṃ sabandhakam / anyeṣāṃ lagnakopetaṃ lekhyasākṣiyutaṃ tathā //
sph_interpretive_translation: Debt owed to kin, allies, and friends must be repaid with bonding intention; debts to others require documented agreement accompanied by witness testimony.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from relational integrity and conscious commitment
Causation is established through documented mutual recognition
Capacity-based responsibility arises from witnessed consent
Restoration logic prioritizes relational completion over transactional discharge
Consciousness alignment necessitates transparent acknowledgment of interdependence
executable_legal_axioms: IF debtor-creditor relationship EXISTS AND type = 'kin/allied' THEN repayment MUST include reaffirmation of relational bond
IF debt involves non-kin THEN fulfillment REQUIRES written record AND attestation by two conscious witnesses
IF no documentation EXISTS AND no witness present THEN obligation remains in potential until conscious recall is achieved
IF repayment occurs WITHOUT consciousness alignment THEN residual karmic distortion PERSISTS in both parties
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating financial or energetic obligations, the Supreme Court must distinguish between relational debts requiring spiritual reaffirmation and contractual debts demanding evidentiary validation. Authority lies in verifying both causal clarity and capacity-consciousness of involved parties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality confirms that unfulfilled obligations generate experiential distortion. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential restoration begins with internal clarity before external resolution. Responsibility aligns proportionally with witnessed capacity. Non-punitive reality rule holds that suffering does not resolve debt—completion does.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate mutual recall session between debtor and creditor under meditative witnessing
Document renewed commitment using sacred writing instruments and conscious scribes
Assign completion ritual wherein both parties offer symbolic exchange restoring energetic balance
Verify integration via biannual follow-up declarations affirming absence of residual tension
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Dharma stands restored through relational integrity and conscious accountability. Justice operates solely for reintegration, never punishment. Reality reflects the supremacy of awakened consciousness as the ultimate adjudicator.
